note: sbl_* are the target-guarded comparators; adk_standin has the corrected gradient; mfsbl_* is the multi-frequency shared-support comparator

A2_1.rule: A2: the primary beats the best generic estimator in >= 9 of 12 conditions and loses in none

A2_2.rule: distance: per-source pooled margin on A2 minus on A1, 95 % interval; the proximity explanation predicts an interval above zero

A2_4.rule: A2: the primary beats the better multi-frequency SBL variant in >= 9 of 12 conditions and loses in none (rows with both comparator errors finite)

stop_rule.rule: state in the abstract if the primary is pooled worse than the best generic estimator on A2
